inlines.v: RESPLEN'DENCE, RESPLEN'DENCY, noun [Latin resplendens, resplendeo; re and splendeo, to shine.] Brilliant luster; vivid brightness; splendor. Son! thou in whom my glory I behold in full resplendence heir of all my might.
